verdict.rationale: An admin audit log is a fair security question for a work-management SaaS like Jira, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an audit log of workspace actions. SAML & SSO, sandboxes and the REST APIs are adjacent features and do not show that admins can review a log of actions.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace
